stem: Which statement expresses an idea about society found in the selection?

options.label: A
options.text: People understand that it is important to protect ecosystems and habitats.

options.label: B
options.text: Inventors around the world are inspired by animal behaviors and features.

options.label: C
options.text: Advances in science help increase human knowledge about nature.

options.label: D
options.text: People work to limit the impact of new technology on the natural world.
